This plot of mine is very small, less than a tenth of a hectare, so I take care of it myself with my family. Since it is "other" crop — not my main maize field — I treat it like a garden plot near the homestead where I can watch over it closely. Here in Mbeya the rains come well from November through April, so I do not need to irrigate. I will put a little manure from my animals and maybe a small amount of urea if I can afford it after buying inputs for my bigger plots, but for such a small piece I rely mostly on manure and my own hands.
